title: Windows: WINDOW_FLAG_MOUSE_PASSTHROUGH does not pass clicks through to external processes or the OS desktop
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.stable.official [ 5b4e0cb0f ] Reproducible ✗
4.6.3.stable.official [ 35e80b3 ] Reproducible ✗

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9144) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900HX (32 threads) - 31.74 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

`WINDOW_FLAG_MOUSE_PASSTHROUGH` does not pass mouse clicks through to the Windows desktop or other application underneath active Godot window. User input is blocked over all window area (clicking, dragging, etc.)

To enable full application mouse pass-through it requires setting `WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT` extended window styles. This approach is already recommended by community, its also used by [glfw library](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/blob/955fbd9d265fa95adf9cb94896eb9a516aa50420/src/win32_window.c#L1953) and verified in [GDExtension workaround](https://github.com/hubacekjakub/Godot-WinMousePassthrough) I created to bypass this issue.



### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new Godot project
2. Add a Window node with these flags set in _ready():

```
always_on_top = true
unfocusable = true
DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_TRANSPARENT, true, get_window_id())
transparent_bg = true
DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_MOUSE_PASSTHROUGH, true, get_window_id())
```

3. Run the project
4. Projects run in the foreground 
5. Clicks for taskbar or desktop icons or any app running behind it are absorbed

**Expected:** 
Clicks are passed through to apps behind it.

**Actual:** 
Clicks are absorbed, our top application consumes mouse input.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[WinMousePassthrough.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29615784/WinMousePassthrough.zip)

```
godot --headless --editor --quit (to import gdextension)
godot .
```
After running the commands you can see window with option to disable/enable full mouse click pass-through. This is done by activating GDExtention API call (`WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT`). This is how community is handling it.
